note: Z-Anatomy Startup.blend (Blender 3.05). Real structure = object parenting through hidden FONT objects named '*.g'; collections are flat per body system.

suffixes..l/.r: left/right geometry (mesh or curve), mirrored copies with identical vertex counts
suffixes..g: hidden FONT object = group node; the parent of its members (this carries the real hierarchy)
suffixes..j: hidden 2-vertex MESH anchor child of its .g group (junction/pivot, no anatomy)
suffixes..t: FONT text label for a sub-part (hidden/helper)
suffixes..i: tiny bone-landmark marker meshes (skeletal system only; none in nervous system)
suffixes..st: FONT tutorial text on the loose Scene Collection (HOW TO ...)
suffixes.no suffix: midline / unpaired structure with its own geometry (e.g. Corpus callosum, Third ventricle)
suffixes.*: asterisk = Terminologia Neuroanatomica / FreeSurfer-derived alternative name for the patch
